fact: The ICT Sector Backward-Looking Joint Sector Review for 2022/2023, whose meeting was held on 26 October 2023, lists the Smart Rwanda Master Plan II, a five-year ICT strategy, under 'Policies under development'.
title: Backward-Looking Joint ICT Sector Review 2022/2023 FY
publisher: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning (MINECOFIN)
